procedure: Reject an existing attempt lock, receipt, stage archive, or retained raw evidence; require explicit root GO and reviewed controller identity.
Reserve the one replay attempt with an exclusive file. Validate exact first execution and result identities, passed summary and admitted counters.
Validate every frozen runtime member as a regular nonsymlink file with matching SHA256, byte count and mode.
Create a never-existing absolute fresh root; create runtime and run siblings without replacement.
Write an exclusive deterministic ZIP, then verify safe canonical exact unique member names, regular file types, modes and full bytes before manual restore.
Verify restored exact runtime file set, member SHA256, bytes, modes and equality to source before execution.
Make one subprocess call with timeout 30 seconds, no shell and no stdin. Record actual command, environment, UTC start/end, elapsed wall time, timeout/launch status and exit code.
Keep stdout, stderr and produced output bytes even if the replay fails. Retain matching copies inside portability/raw for the final package.
Verify exact restored runtime members and original frozen source again; compare first versus replay raw bytes, parsed JSON, summary and counters.
Save REPLAY_RECEIPT.json. A failure remains preserved with no automatic retry. The distinct scientific decision reviewer, not this contributor, owns any PROMOTE decision.
